show.description: After her sister drugs her and leaks her private photos, a young woman is publicly shamed and cast out of her home. Struggling alone, she rebuilds her life with resilience. Years later, to escape a harasser, she impulsively claims a stranger as her husband, and he agrees to marry her hiding that he is a billionaire. As love grows, buried secrets resurface, threatening to destroy everything.
